scenes.say: The casino doesn't need a big edge to beat you. It just needs a bigger wallet and more time.
Gambler's ruin: play a slightly losing game long enough, and a small bankroll is almost guaranteed to hit zero.
Three groups play a game they win {a_p} of the time, one unit a bet, with {a_start}, {b_start} or {c_start} units.
In a slightly losing game, time is your enemy. In a slightly winning game, it's your friend.

takeaway: In a slightly losing game, time is your enemy. In a slightly winning game, it's your friend.
